snippet.title: Fathom's End | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Fathom’s End is a first-person lighthouse keeper simulation set far out in the Atlantic. Maintain the light, endure the isolation, and keep the station running through long nights, unpredictable weather and scarce supplies.

Fathom's End enters early access on the 16th April 2026.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4154940/Fathoms_End
Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/rmsaBeT8Md

Trailer produced by Chris Ferris.
Higgs voiced by Mike Harrison-Wood.
